input = sys.stdin.read

def full_glasses(n, t):
    glasses = [[0] * (i + 1) for i in range(n)]
    glasses[0][0] = t

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if glasses[i][j] > 1:
                overflow = glasses[i][j] - 1
                glasses[i][j] = 1
                if i + 1 < n:
                    glasses[i + 1][j] += overflow / 2
                    glasses[i + 1][j + 1] += overflow / 2

    count_full = sum(glasses[i][j] >= 1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1))
    return count_full
